label: {{mark}} books a normal fare
note: Allowed: travel agents may book fares, and 800 is under every limit.

label: {{mark}}'s agent books a large fare, unattended
note: Held until {{priya}} approves it on the Approvals page.

label: {{mark}} books a fare over the hard cap
note: Denied for everyone over 10000. An approval cannot change this.

label: {{mark}} pays an invoice
note: Denied: only the finance group may pay invoices, and nobody in this demo is in finance.

label: {{mary}} tries to book a fare
note: Denied: analysts may search and open tickets, but only travel agents may book fares.

label: {{mark}} books a fare after the tool's schema changed
note: Denied: a tool whose description or schema changed since it was approved is blocked for everyone.

label: A finance user with the payments:write scope pays an invoice
note: Allowed: finance may pay invoices with the payments:write scope.

label: The same large fare after {{priya}} approves (one approval)
note: Allowed once someone has approved: the hold rule stops applying.
